intended_object: A proof-internal shorthand from the Schoenflies development: the existing outer graph of a generated pair, with its vertices placed by `P.src.pos` on the source curve. It is used to build the mixed graph in the local overlay relabelling step.
explanation: The definition is an `abbrev` that ignores its argument `_w` and just returns `P.str.outerGraph.map P.src.pos`. That is the abstract outer graph with its vertices sent to their positions in the plane. It exists only so the proof can write `w.outerGraph.union w.innerGraph` and state compatibility lemmas about it. It belongs to the internal machinery of this library's proof of the Schoenflies theorem and has no standalone counterpart in the mathematical literature, so it is a technical device rather than a mathematical object.
